description: Canonical schema. It describes a list-price catalog, not billing data. Column names and allowed values follow FinOps FOCUS v1.4 (Cost and Usage dataset) where an equivalent exists; fields marked 'Custom column' have no FOCUS equivalent. FOCUS columns come first, custom columns last. Prices are only comparable within the same PricingUnit, PricingCategory, CommitmentType, CommitmentTerm and Tenancy. PricingUnit values are provisional until aligned with the FOCUS Unit Format

fields.name: ServiceProviderName
fields.title: Service Provider
fields.description: FOCUS v1.4 ServiceProviderName, Name of the entity that provides the service. Constant per source file

fields.name: ServiceCategory
fields.title: Service category
fields.description: FOCUS v1.4 ServiceCategory, Highest-level classification of the service, used for cross-provider comparison. Container services are classified as Compute and backup services as Storage

fields.name: ServiceName
fields.title: Service name
fields.description: FOCUS v1.4 ServiceName, Display name of the service offering (e.g. Virtual Machines, Compute Engine, Amazon RDS). Each ServiceName belongs to exactly one ServiceCategory

fields.name: SkuId
fields.title: SKU id
fields.description: FOCUS v1.4 SkuId, Provider-specified identifier of the SKU. Unique only together with ServiceProviderName. The same SkuId can appear in several rows that differ in price tier, commitment term or pricing category

fields.name: ChargeDescription
fields.title: Charge description
fields.description: FOCUS v1.4 ChargeDescription, Human-readable description of the charge, for display only

fields.name: RegionId
fields.title: Region id
fields.description: FOCUS v1.4 RegionId, Provider region identifier (e.g. southamerica-west1, brazilsouth). Empty for rows without a single region, such as AWS data transfer between regions

fields.name: PricingCategory
fields.title: Pricing category
fields.description: FOCUS v1.4 PricingCategory, Pricing model of the price. Standard = predetermined rate, including on-demand, pay-as-you-go and tiered pricing. Dynamic = variable rate set by the provider (Spot, preemptible, Azure Low Priority). Committed = reduced price under a commitment discount (reservations, savings plans, committed use discounts). Other = none of these

fields.name: PricingUnit
fields.title: Pricing unit
fields.description: FOCUS v1.4 PricingUnit, Normalized unit that ListUnitPrice refers to. Provider spellings (Hrs, hours, GBy.h, ...) are mapped to these values before import

fields.name: ListUnitPrice
fields.title: List unit price (USD)
fields.description: FOCUS v1.4 ListUnitPrice, List price per PricingUnit, in USD

fields.name: SkuName
fields.title: SKU name / instance type
fields.description: Custom column, Instance type or SKU name (e.g. Standard_D14, db.r5d.24xlarge). Empty when the provider data has no such name (GCP)

fields.name: PriceComponent
fields.title: Price component
fields.description: Custom column, What the price covers: a whole instance or one component such as CPU or RAM (GCP prices these separately). Not FOCUS ResourceType, which describes a billed resource and must be null without a ResourceId.

fields.name: StorageClass
fields.title: Storage class
fields.description: Custom column, Conditional: storage services. Access tier of the stored data: Standard, InfrequentAccess (S3 IA, Azure Cool, Nearline), Cold (Coldline), Archive, or Automatic (S3 Intelligent-Tiering, Autoclass). Empty otherwise

fields.name: ServiceTier
fields.title: Service tier
fields.description: Custom column, Conditional: databases and compute. Provider edition or tier that changes the price for the same size (e.g. General Purpose, Memory Optimized, Enterprise, Enterprise Plus). Empty otherwise

fields.name: RegionGroup
fields.title: Region group
fields.description: Custom column, Coarse geographic group derived from the region by lookup table, so regions of different providers can be compared. Empty when RegionId is empty

fields.name: CommitmentTerm
fields.title: Commitment term
fields.description: Custom column, Length of the commitment on Committed prices. Empty for Standard and Dynamic prices. FOCUS has no commitment term column

fields.name: CommitmentType
fields.title: Commitment type
fields.description: Custom column, Kind of commitment behind a Committed price: Reservation (bound to a specific resource, usage-based) or SavingsPlan (spend-based). Empty for Standard and Dynamic prices. FOCUS CommitmentDiscountType requires a CommitmentDiscountId, which a price catalog does not have

fields.name: Tenancy
fields.title: Tenancy
fields.description: Custom column, Shared hardware (default) or dedicated / sole-tenant hardware. Empty when not applicable

fields.name: OperatingSystem
fields.title: Operating system
fields.description: Custom column, Operating system when the price depends on it. Empty otherwise

fields.name: TierStart
fields.title: Tier start
fields.description: Custom column, Start of the price tier, in PricingUnit terms. Empty when the price has no tiers

fields.name: TierEnd
fields.title: Tier end
fields.description: Custom column, End of the price tier, in PricingUnit terms. Empty when the tier is open-ended (AWS writes Inf)

fields.name: DatabaseEngine
fields.title: Database engine
fields.description: Custom column, Engine of database services (e.g. MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server). Empty otherwise

fields.name: DeploymentOption
fields.title: Deployment option
fields.description: Custom column, Availability setup of database services (e.g. Single-AZ, Multi-AZ). Empty otherwise

fields.name: VCpu
fields.title: vCPU count
fields.description: Custom column, Number of vCPUs, used as a performance proxy. Empty when it could not be extracted

fields.name: MemoryGiB
fields.title: Memory (GiB)
fields.description: Custom column, Memory in GiB, used as a performance proxy. Empty when it could not be extracted
